Entries.UsedFor: Documenting that Blackbaud SKY API's incremental-sync request query param name (last_modified) differs from the response field name (date_modified) tracked for max-watermark, per SourceFieldInfo.IncrementalWatermarkField semantics (which names the response-observed field, not the request query-param name). Also cross-checked directly against 4 in-scope OpenAPI specs confirming both distinct names are present.
Entries.Excerpt: SourceFieldInfo.IncrementalWatermarkField: "Source field name that marks \"last changed\" for incremental sync. When introspecting a source whose docs (or describe response) name a watermark field, surface it here..." (types.ts:367-374). OpenAPI specs (constituents.swagger.json etc.) declare request query param "last_modified" while response schemas across 10 in-scope specs (church-mgmt, constituents, fundraising, fenxt-gl, fenxt-payable, gifts, prospects, renxt-combined, renxt-reports, renxt-events, renxt-interactions) expose a distinct "date_modified" response field.

Entries.UsedFor: Resolving Integration.CredentialTypeID: authoring a new 'Blackbaud SKY API' credential type modeling the vendor's documented dual-credential requirement (OAuth2 authorization-code confidential-application token pair via oauth2.sky.blackbaud.com AND a separate, always-required 'bb-api-subscription-key' header), since no existing credential type in metadata/credential-types/ models a second required header-secret alongside an OAuth2 token.
Entries.Excerpt: SKY API requires TWO credential parts on every request: (1) OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow access token in 'Authorization: Bearer <token>', and (2) a static SKY API subscription key in the 'Bb-Api-Subscription-Key' header. Both parts are REQUIRED on every call; missing the subscription key or the bearer token independently returns 401. OAuth endpoints (confirmed identically across all 4 in-scope OpenAPI specs' securityDefinitions.skyApiOAuth): authorizationUrl=https://oauth2.sky.blackbaud.com/authorization, tokenUrl=https://oauth2.sky.blackbaud.com/token.

Entries.Excerpt: "host": "api.sky.blackbaud.com", "basePath": "/", "schemes": ["https"] -- identical host declared in gifts.swagger.json, fundraising.swagger.json, and prospects.swagger.json.

Entries.UsedFor: Confirming Integration.BatchMaxRequestCount (per-app rate-limit count): the vendor's own live docs state a hard rate limit of 10 calls per second for the Standard subscription tier (the tier used unless a customer/partner has an upgraded tier).
Entries.Excerpt: "Our rate limit is currently 10 calls per second" (developer.blackbaud.com/skyapi/docs/basics, rendered 2026-06-29). Corroborated by the vendor's own error-response example: 429 -> {"statusCode": 429, "message": "Rate limit is exceeded. Try again in 1 second."}, and by the prior BlackbaudConnector.ts implementation comment ('Rate limits: 10 calls/second hard limit').

Entries.UsedFor: Confirming Integration.BatchRequestWaitTime (per-app rate-limit window, seconds): the vendor's own live docs and 429 error example both express the rate-limit window as 1 second.
